name: Shawarma-Spiced Chicken & Potatoes
subtitle: Sheet-pan chicken, baby potatoes and carrots, with garlic yogurt and cucumber-tomato salad

macros.portion: About 5½ oz cooked chicken, 1½ cups roasted potatoes, ½ cup carrots, ¼ cup garlic yogurt and 1 cup salad.
macros.note: Rough estimate from standard nutrition values for the listed amounts, not a lab number.

before: Chicken thawed in the fridge (allow 1–2 days).
Start **~55 min** before dinner. Prep happens while the potatoes roast.
notes: Shawarma-spiced, not shawarma: there's no spit, so the char comes from a hot pan and an optional 2-minute broil. Breast chunks dry out fast, so pull them at 160°F; they coast to 165°F while you plate. The carrots get crowded once the chicken goes on, which is fine since they're nearly done by then.

steps.title: Oven and spice blend
steps.body: Put both sheet pans in the oven and heat it to 425°F. In a small bowl, mix **2 tsp cumin + 2 tsp paprika + 1 tsp coriander + 1 tsp garlic powder + ½ tsp turmeric + ½ tsp cinnamon + ½ tsp pepper** and the cayenne if using.

steps.title: Potatoes and carrots in
steps.body: Halve **2½ lb baby potatoes**. In a large bowl, toss with **1 Tbsp olive oil + ¾ tsp salt + 1 tsp of the spice blend**. In the same bowl, toss **1 lb baby carrots** with **2 tsp olive oil + ¼ tsp salt + ½ tsp of the spice blend**. Potatoes cut-side down on pan 1; carrots on pan 2. Roast **15 min**.

steps.title: Chicken ready
steps.body: While they roast, pat **1¾ lb chicken breast** dry and cut into 1½-inch chunks. In the same bowl, toss with **the rest of the spice blend + 1 Tbsp olive oil + 1¼ tsp salt + zest of 1 lemon**.

steps.title: Chicken in
steps.body: Flip the potatoes. Push the carrots to one end of pan 2 and spread the chicken on the rest in one layer. Roast **15–18 min**, until the thickest chunk reads 160°F.

steps.title: Yogurt and salad
steps.body: While the chicken roasts: grate **1 small clove garlic** into **1 cup Greek yogurt** with **1 Tbsp lemon juice + ¼ tsp salt**, and loosen with **1–2 Tbsp water**. Dice **1 cucumber** and halve **10 oz grape tomatoes** into a bowl. Mix **1 Tbsp lemon juice + 2 tsp olive oil + ¼ tsp salt** in a cup, but don't dress the salad yet.

steps.title: Optional char
steps.body: For browned edges, switch to broil and broil pan 2 for 2 min on the top rack. Watch it; paprika burns fast.

steps.title: Serve
steps.body: Squeeze a lemon wedge over the chicken. Dress the dinner share of the salad. Plate potatoes, carrots and chicken with garlic yogurt and salad.

after: Pack 2 lunches: potatoes, carrots and chicken together; yogurt and undressed salad with its dressing in small containers.
